scripts.dev:all: powershell -Command "Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run dev:api' -NoNewWindow; npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }))"
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types apps/api/tests/security.test.ts apps/api/tests/api.test.ts apps/api/tests/github.test.ts apps/api/tests/intelligence.test.ts apps/api/tests/chain.test.ts
